# PillDrops

> PillDrops is a self-hosted engine for running untrusted and AI-generated code:
> each sandbox is an isolated microVM (or container) that can run commands, host an
> app server on a preview URL, pause and resume with its memory intact, and be
> copied or moved. This file is served by a PillDrops server; paths below are
> relative to it. Source: https://github.com/pilldrops-oss/pilldrops

## Access

- Auth is `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The operator key is minted on the server's
  first start; `POST /v1/keys` creates more.
- Env vars (SDKs + CLI resolve in this order): PILLDROPS_API_KEY / PILLDROPS_API_URL,
  then PILLDROPS_*, E2B_*, SANDBOX_* (so code written for the E2B SDK runs unchanged)

## Quickstart (pick one)

- Python: `pip install pilldrops` → `from pilldrops import Sandbox` →
  `Sandbox.create(template="python-3.11").run("python -c 'print(2+2)'")`
- JS/TS: `npm install @pilldrops/sdk` → `import { Sandbox } from '@pilldrops/sdk'` →
  `await Sandbox.create({ template: 'python-3.11' })`
- CLI: `curl -fsSL <this server>/install.sh | sh` (or `npm i -g @pilldrops/cli`) →
  `pilldrops login --api-url <this server> --key <key>` →
  `pilldrops sandbox create --template python-3.11`
- Raw HTTP: `POST /v1/sandboxes {"template":"python-3.11"}` →
  `POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/exec {"cmd":"echo hi"}`

## MCP (native agent tools)

- Remote: `claude mcp add --transport http pilldrops <this server>/mcp --header
  "Authorization: Bearer <key>"` — served by the control plane (orchestrator).
- Local: `claude mcp add pilldrops -- pilldrops mcp` — the CLI serves the same tools
  over stdio, using its stored login.

## For AI agents (important)

- Run `pilldrops ai` — the complete agent catalog: every command, JSON output contract,
  exit codes, copy-paste workflows (run code / deploy app with preview URL / debug via
  logs+ps+metrics / CI gates), and an error→remediation table. `pilldrops ai --json`
  returns it machine-structured.
- `pilldrops doctor --json` self-diagnoses auth/connectivity. `pilldrops upgrade` self-updates.
- All commands accept `--json`. Errors are `{"error","code","hint"}` on stderr.
- App preview URLs require the app to bind the injected `$PORT` env var (hardcoded
  ports are the #1 cause of preview 502s).

## API surface (Bearer auth, JSON)

- POST /v1/sandboxes — create (template|image, start, ports, env, vcpu, memory_mb,
  storage_mb, timeout, idle_timeout, runtime, public, network). Returns {id, status, url?, ...}.
  Previews are private by default (URL needs the returned token); pass public:true
  (CLI: --public) for a shareable preview URL that needs no token.
- GET /v1/sandboxes · GET/DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{id} — list / inspect / destroy
- POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/exec {cmd, cwd?, timeout?} → {stdout, stderr, exit_code}
- GET|POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/files?path= — read / write files
- POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/pause · /resume · /timeout · /start · /fork · /move — lifecycle
- GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/logs · /metrics — debugging
- POST|GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/backups · POST …/backups/{bkp}/restore — disk backups (node
  needs an object store); schedule them with POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/config
  {"backups": {"period": "24h", "retention": "7d"}}
- GET /v1/templates · /v1/usage · /v1/history — catalog, metered usage, past sandboxes
- Machine spec: /openapi.json

## By use case (template → step-by-step guide)

- Code interpreter / data analysis: template `code-interpreter` — /guides/code-interpreter
- Browser automation / scraping: template `playwright` (Chromium pre-baked) — /guides/browser-automation
- Run untrusted user code: template `python-3.11` with vcpu/mem/timeout caps — /guides/untrusted-code
- Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Amp): template `node`, CLI installed
  through exec — /guides/coding-agents
- Computer use / desktop agents: template `desktop` (Linux desktop over VNC) — /guides/computer-use
- Full-stack app previews: template `node` + start/ports — /guides/app-preview
- Evals & RL rollouts at scale: template `python-3.11`, one sandbox per rollout — /guides/evals
- CI for AI-written code: /guides/ci-tests
- Custom images (any Dockerfile): /guides/custom-images
- Long-running / background agents: /guides/long-running
- Data pipelines / ETL: /guides/data-pipeline

## Docs

- /sdk — Python/JS SDKs + CLI: install, auth, every Sandbox method, preview URLs, custom images
- /docs — the interactive API reference: every endpoint, live playground
- /guides — agent patterns, CI, app hosting
- [Runnable examples](https://github.com/pilldrops-oss/pilldrops-examples): code
  interpreter, browser automation, untrusted code, coding agent, app preview, evals
  at scale, MCP, CLI tour
- [Running your own server](https://github.com/pilldrops-oss/pilldrops#quick-start)
